description.zh: 键集分页 token，获取第一页数据时无需传入，否则需要传入前一页查询结果中的 nextToken 字段
description.en: The token for keyset pagination. Omit this parameter for the first page. For subsequent pages, use the `nextToken` value from the previous response.

description.zh: 分页排序属性，决定根据何种属性进行记录排序；推荐在实现严格遍历时，使用 id 属性
description.en: The property to sort the results by. For consistent iteration, use the `id` property.

description.zh: 分页模式参数，目前只支持键集分页 keyset 模式
description.en: The pagination method. Currently, only `keyset` pagination is supported.

description.zh: 分页尺寸参数，决定一页最多返回多少对象
description.en: The maximum number of items to return per page.

description.zh: 分页排序升降序，asc 为升序，desc 为降序；推荐在实现严格遍历时，使用升序
description.en: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` (ascending) and `desc` (descending). Use ascending order for consistent iteration.
